standard_prerequisites.name: Regular local rings are UFDs
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the gcd factorization f_i = f g_i with gcd(g_1, ..., g_r) = 1 underlying the whole argument.

standard_prerequisites.name: Dimension theory in a two-dimensional local ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Standard dimension theory of Noetherian local rings (height-one primes and the maximal ideal as the only point of V(g) in dimension 2)
standard_prerequisites.use: Rules out height-one primes over the g_i, leaving either (g_i) = A or V(g_i) = {m}.

core_obligations: Gcd factorization (proof lines 4043-4053): writing I = (f_1, ..., f_r) with f_i = f g_i and gcd of the g_i equal to 1, no height-one prime lies over the g_i; hence either (g_i) = A, giving I = (f), or m = sqrt((g_i)).
Reduced case (proof lines 4055-4062): I radical; if f is a unit then I = m; otherwise f^n maps to zero in A/I and reducedness forces f in I, so I = (f).
Depth-one case (proof lines 4064-4069): m is not associated to A/I; the class of f is annihilated by all g_i, so it is zero, and I = (f).
proof_roadmap: Factor the generators through their gcd in the UFD and analyse the ideal spanned by the quotients.
Split on whether the quotient ideal is the unit ideal or m-primary.
Use radicality to conclude I = m or I = (f) in case (1).
Use depth one to kill the class of f and conclude I = (f) in case (2).

The proof (lines 4043-4069) is complete: the UFD gcd factorization with the height-one exclusion and the dimension-2 dichotomy, the radical case concluding I = m or I = (f), and the depth-one case killing the class of f via non-associativity of m. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a compact local-algebra classification with correctly ordered steps.
